item.title: Battlefield 6 Controversy Erupts Over Dev Brian Odet’s Political Posts About Charlie Kirk’s Death
item.description: Yep. The Battlefield franchise has never been shy of chaos. Usually, the drama stays inside the game, crumbling skyscrapers, jets colliding midair, the usual spectacle.

item.title: Ghost of Yotei Studio Finally Breaks Silence With Apology After Charlie Kirk Assassin Joke Sparks PlayStation Boycott
item.description: Sucker Punch finally blinked. After boycotts, outrage, and an online circus that made Ghost of Yotei feel less like a hot PlayStation exclusive and more like a cable news segment, the studio dropped an ‘official’ statement (in an interview, so, yeah).

item.title: Third-Party Developers Say Nintendo’s Switch 2 Is Already a Headache
item.description: Nintendo loves a secret. That’s not news. But according to developers, the company might be overdoing it with the Switch 2.

item.title: Some Mega Evolutions in Pokémon Legends: Z-A Locked Behind Switch Online
item.description: Getting every Mega Evolution in Pokémon Legends: Z-A might take more than patience.

item.title: Battlefield 6 Cosmetic Economy Under Scrutiny Ahead Of Phantom Edition Launch
item.description: Battlefield 6 is speeding toward launch with real momentum. Fast matches, clean gunfeel, grounded cosmetics, and the classic Operation Firestorm map all point the right way.
